profile.name: Ashraf Kandil
profile.tagline: Designing and delivering scalable, enterprise-grade software with 30+ years of experience
profile.shortBio: Lead software engineer and architect with 30+ years of experience designing scalable, enterprise-grade .NET, web, and mobile solutions, from architecture to hands-on full-stack development.

bio: Over 30 years, I've designed, architected, and built enterprise-grade software across financial services, insurance, and other complex business domains. My expertise spans the full software development lifecycle, from system architecture and technical design to hands-on development, performance optimization, and production support. I specialize in building scalable, secure, maintainable, and high-performance applications using modern .NET technologies, C#, ASP.NET Core, distributed systems, web technologies, and relational and NoSQL databases. With deep experience in enterprise application architecture, design patterns, software modernization, and web and mobile technologies, I combine architectural thinking with strong engineering execution to deliver reliable solutions that address complex business challenges. I'm equally comfortable defining technical direction, refactoring legacy systems, optimizing application performance, and working hands-on with code. Throughout my career, I've delivered reliable, well-engineered solutions for demanding business environments.

I've contributed to mission-critical enterprise platforms, collaborated with cross-functional teams, established engineering standards, and mentored developers. My approach emphasizes clean architecture, maintainable code, engineering best practices, and pragmatic technical decisions that balance business needs with long-term scalability. I'm passionate about software craftsmanship, solving complex technical problems, and designing robust software architectures that evolve with changing business requirements and emerging technologies.

personalProjects.title: Marwa Crazy Cakes — AI Bakery Website
personalProjects.description: A production-ready marketing site for Marwa Crazy Cakes, a custom bakery in Milton, Ontario, built with the Next.js App Router. All copy, gallery, testimonials, pricing and event types are driven by a seeded SQLite database, and a free talking AI avatar named Sprinkles — powered by Google Gemini — answers visitor questions out loud in English or Arabic, jumps to the right gallery category, and pre-fills the quote form.
features: Talking AI avatar (Sprinkles) with voice input and speech output in English and Arabic, on Google Gemini's free tier
SQLite-driven content: gallery categories, images and videos, testimonials, pricing and event types, all seedable via a script
Gallery with category filtering, pagination, lightbox and video playback, plus reviews, pricing and quote pages
Next.js App Router UI styled with Tailwind CSS 4 and shadcn/ui, with ESLint and Prettier tooling

personalProjects.title: Marwa Crazy Cakes — Mobile App
personalProjects.description: The official iOS and Android companion app for the Marwa Crazy Cakes website, built with Expo and React Native in TypeScript. It mirrors the full web experience — hero carousel, gallery, reviews, pricing and contact — with an adaptive layout that switches from a phone tab bar to a tablet sidebar, and keeps all content on-device in expo-sqlite so the app works offline.
features: Adaptive phone/tablet UI: bottom tab bar on phones, 240px sidebar on tablets and landscape (≥720dp)
On-device expo-sqlite database seeded from the live website, with an npm script that re-syncs content and media
Hero carousel with autoplay, category gallery with full-screen image/video players, reviews with ratings, pricing table and validated contact form
Shared design tokens, Google fonts and watermarked brand assets matching the website pixel for pixel

personalProjects.title: PortfolioAI — AI Portfolio with Talking Avatar
personalProjects.description: This portfolio site itself: a React 19 and TypeScript front end served by an Express API over a SQLite content store that is reseedable from a single JSON file. Its AI avatar uses the Web Speech API to narrate every section and project card, answers questions locally from the same seed data the pages render (with an optional LLM fallback through OpenRouter or Ollama), and keeps spoken summaries and on-screen content perfectly in sync.
features: AI avatar with speech recognition and text-to-speech that narrates each section and project card on demand
Local keyword answer engine sourced from the same seed data the pages render, plus optional LLM fallback (OpenRouter or Ollama)
Express API over a normalized SQLite schema for profile, experience and projects, reseedable with one command
Vitest and Testing Library unit tests covering the avatar knowledge base, navigation targets and UI components
